newsitem.title: GERMANY: Germans seek small free market wheat exports.
newsitem.headline: Germans seek small free market wheat exports.

text.p: German grain traders placed bids for small free market wheat volumes at the weekly EU export tender, seeking taxes on some tonnages and rebates on others, intervention board BLE said on Thursday.
Traders bid for two lots of 2,500 tonnes each of soft wheat, with taxes of 0.12 Ecus and 0.50 Ecus a tonne tax respectively.
They also bid for two lots of 1,000 tonnes each with a subsidy of 0.25 Ecus/T sought on one and 0.70 Ecus on the other.
They bid for export restitutions of 25.99 Ecus a tonne for 2,500 tonnes of free market rye, BLE also said.
There were no free market rice bids. --Hamburg newsroom, +49-40-41903275
